stage: preregistration: written after code + smoke tests on tiny/disposable inputs, BEFORE any campaign chunk ran

hypothesis.statement: The best constant C* in sum_k sum_{I in A_k} |L_I(F0,F1,F2)| <= C* prod_v ||F_v||_{L^3} (dyadic triangular Hilbert form; upstream Theorem 1.1 has constant 40, NOT Lean-formalized) equals 5/2.
hypothesis.known_lower_bound: C* >= 5/2: exact +-1 witness at N=4 (sign of results/openai_math/hypotheses/H5/best_inputs_N4.npz, h5_exact.py verify)

goals.1_beat_5_2: search for any input with ratio > 5/2 + 1e-9: Kronecker lifts of the N=4 witness with Walsh (XOR-character) blocks in both orders (full enumeration N=5 d=1 and N=6 d=2; random samples N=7 d=3 (1500) and N=8 d=4 (400), half of them coupled (u,v),(v,t),(t,u)); witness (x) rotated/sign-flipped witness at N=8; multi-scale random sign products evaluated exactly (N=5: 3000, N=6: 1500); Hoelder ascent from the top Walsh lifts, from multi-scale signs, from multi-scale Gaussian sums, from continuation N-1 -> N of the committed witnesses with noise sigma in {0.05, 0.2, 0.5} (N=5..7) and {0.1, 0.3} (N=8), and plain Gaussian at N=8
goals.2_explain_5_2: h5_multiscale.py explain on sign(best_inputs_N4.npz) -> explain_N4.json: exact per-scale parts, the integer value of every admissible triple with a saturation flag (|int| = b^3), and the 2D Walsh spectrum of each F_v; then a conjecture for the extremisers, labelled as a conjecture
goals.3_restricted_upper_bound: exact exhaustive maximum over all +-1 inputs at N=1 (2^12) and N=2 (2^48, reduced by F0 -> -F0, F1 -> -F1 and the linear-in-F2 identity max_{F2 in {+-1}} sum_t |<c_t, F2>| = max_{s in {+-1}^6, s_0 = +1} ||sum_t s_t c_t||_1: 2^30 pairs x 32 patterns in 32 chunks of 1024 F0 representatives); a paper proof attempt for real inputs at N=1 written into the lane markdown note. N=3 exhaustive is declared INFEASIBLE in advance (22 terms -> 2^21 patterns per (F0, F1) pair, 2^126 pairs)

statistic: certified exceedance: the exact integer decision ratio(q) > 5/2 + 1e-9 for an integer input q (a quantized real candidate, or its sign rounding), decided in Python integers as S^3 * den^3 > num^3 * P * size^3 with threshold num/den = 5/2 + 1/10^9, S = |T_int| + sum_k 2^{-k} sum_I |int_I|, P = prod_v sum |q_v|^3. Three integer versions of every ascent candidate are certified: (i) quantized to the largest int64-safe width (15 bits at N=4 ... 11 bits at N=8; relative resolution ~3e-5..5e-4), (ii) its sign rounding (also checked against h5_exact.exact_ratio), and (iii) whenever the float ratio exceeds 5/2 - 1e-6, a high-precision version x/max|x| * 2^53 in Python ints evaluated exactly by sign-magnitude limb splitting (int64 per limb combination, recombined per triple in Python ints before |.|); (iii) loses nothing beyond float64's own 2^-53 relative resolution of the candidate. Exhaustive N=1/N=2 maxima are exact integers compared with the same threshold. Secondary: best float ratio per chunk; exact +-1 maxima at N=1 and N=2.

verdict_categories.REFUTED: at least one chunk with passing controls has a Haar-form candidate certified > 5/2 + 1e-9 by the exact integer certifier (any of the three versions; for +-1 candidates the value must also agree with h5_exact.exact_ratio), or a complete exhaustive chunk whose rechecked maximum exceeds 5/2 + 1e-9, AND the power control passed
verdict_categories.NOT_REFUTED: no certified exceedance and the power control passed (a numerical search cannot prove an upper bound)
verdict_categories.UNCERTIFIED_FLOAT_EXCEEDANCE: a float ratio > 5/2 + 1e-9 whose quantized, sign-rounded AND high-precision (2^53) versions all fail certification: reported as an instrument discrepancy, never as a refutation
verdict_categories.CRASH: a chunk whose controls fail is excluded; if the power control fails, the lane verdict is CRASH
verdict_categories.BLOCKED: a stage that cannot run (e.g. a walsh_top ascent whose source chunk is missing) is reported BLOCKED with the reason
verdict_categories.skipped_by_preregistered_timing_rule: N=8 ascent chunks when one timed sweep takes > 8 s
verdict_categories.incomplete: a chunk that hit its 420 s budget; what it evaluated still counts, what it did not is listed

decision_rule: REFUTED if any certified ratio > 5/2 + 1e-9 (exact integer comparison, controls passed in that chunk, power control passed); otherwise NOT_REFUTED. The exhaustive N=2 search counts as an exact computer-assisted result 'max over +-1 inputs at N=2 = value' only if all 32 E2 chunks are complete and every chunk argmax rechecks equal under h5_exact.exact_ratio. summary.json excludes any chunk whose recorded code sha256 or input-witness sha256 differs from the hashes below.

controls.run_in_every_chunk: controls(); if any check fails the chunk is 'crash' and its numbers do not count
positive: sign(best_inputs_N4.npz): h5_exact gives exactly 5/2; the certifier says NOT > 5/2 + 1e-9 and IS > 5/2 - 1e-9
ones-block Kronecker lift N=4 -> N=5 keeps ratio^3 == 125/8 exactly
integer certifier vs h5_dyadic.ratio on random integer inputs at N=2,3: relative diff < 1e-12
integer S vs h5_dyadic.brute_force_term direct loops at N=2: abs diff < 1e-12
lane gradient == h5_dyadic.gradient_first at N=3: max diff < 1e-14
exhaustive kernel: term-list sum == int_parts on 3 random +-1 triples at N=2; pattern maximum == brute-force maximum over all 2^16 F2 for a random (F0, F1)
negative: Haar-free form at F = 1: ratio^3 == 64 (N=3) and 343 (N=6), i.e. ratio N + 1, so the instrument sees an unbounded form
controls.power: chunk P01_power_haarfree_N4: the full pipeline (Gaussian init, ascent, quantize, exact certify) on the Haar-free form at N=4 must report a certified exceedance of 5/2 + 1e-9; this guards against a certifier that always answers no

seeds: numpy default_rng(20261007000 + offset), offsets fixed in campaign(); disjoint from earlier H5 seeds 1000-1039, 6000-6039, 7000-7011; controls use 424242; smoke tests used 101, 5, 9, 77, 31, 4, 0, 1, 2

budget.cpu: at most 2 concurrent python3 processes; OPENBLAS/OMP/MKL/NUMEXPR threads forced to 1 inside the script
budget.per_bash_call: < 9 min (one chunk per call; resumable: an existing chunk JSON is skipped)
budget.cap_rule: no new chunk is launched once the summed elapsed_s of finished chunks exceeds 6 CPU-hours; unlaunched chunks are reported missing (the per-chunk worst case 71 x 420 s = 8.3 h is not expected: E2 chunks take about 100 s)
budget.expected_cpu_hours: about 2 (exhaustive N=2 about 55 CPU-min at the measured single-thread 0.10 s per F0 representative; an N=8 high-precision certification about 40 s, 75 s reserved per N=8 restart)

run_order: C00, P01, E01, E2_*, W_* and S_* before A_* (walsh_top ascents read their W_* source chunk)
interpreter: /usr/bin/python3 3.10.12, numpy 2.2.6, pytest 9.1.1; hypothesis is NOT installed for this interpreter, so the tests use seeded loops
